There are many things wrong with the attached code that Marcus pointed out, but when I run it, I get an assert from Eigen

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'modelString' NOW (CHAIN 1).
R: /opt/site-library/RcppEigen/include/Eigen/src/Core/products/GeneralBlockPanelKernel.h:1120: void Eigen::internal::gemm_pack_lhs<stan::agrad::var, long, 2, 1, 0, false, false>::operator()(Scalar *, const Scalar *restrict, Index, Index, Index, Index, Index) [Scalar = stan::agrad::var, Index = long, Pack1 = 2, Pack2 = 1, StorageOrder = 0, Conjugate = false, PanelMode = false]: Assertion `((!PanelMode) && stride==0 && offset==0) || (PanelMode && stride>=depth && offset<=stride)' failed.
Aborted

Ideally, we would catch something before it gets that far.

Ben

On Wednesday, October 31, 2012 1:18:45 PM UTC-4, eric.c.brown wrote:
I think I'm getting closer, also had another problem in my stan code. The version attached to this compiles ok, but I get caught on:

TRANSLATING MODEL 'modelString' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL 'modelString' NOW.
SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'modelString' NOW (CHAIN 1).
Error in sampler$call_sampler(args_list[[i]]) :
  Error in function stan::prob::normal_log(N4stan5agrad3varE): Random variable is nan:0, but must not be nan!
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

It seems like something is not getting set. But how do I interpret this error message to find out which variable/statement is being problematic?
